before_taxonomy.classification_basis: Human scammers used AI-generated public-figure endorsements, fabricated news and synthetic social proof to create false investment authority and induce economic transfers. Human-operated scammers used AI-generated public-figure endorsements and fabricated investment news and social proof to advance fraudulent investment solicitation. ASIC attributed financial losses to these AI-mediated campaigns; their impersonation was an instrumental means of securing investment choices that would not have been authorised on the truthful basis that the endorsements and claimed investment authority were fabricated. The assessment is bounded to the campaign evidence and does not attribute each reported dollar or victim to a particular generated image. ASIC describes human scammers deliberately misusing named public figures’ images to fabricate investment endorsements. Those operators used access to identifiable likenesses as sufficient authority for the false identity-bound portrayals; the requester-side failure is supported without requiring a generator’s hidden consent-control trace. Deepfake public-figure endorsements, fabricated news and comments formed an AI-mediated social-proof pathway to fraudulent investment choices.

clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Identity, solicitation and influence interpretations can analyse the same reported deceptive material.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The reported funnel takes people from advertisements to fake articles and detail collection, then scripted calls, false platforms and sometimes small profit payments.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Later human contact and trust-building payments are separate stages, not a single observed victim trace.

clauses.source_paraphrase: FY26 Scamwatch losses of A$7.4 million concern reported impersonations of the listed public figures. ASIC separately reports more than 19,400 scam takedowns across types.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Losses and takedowns are different aggregates; neither is an AI-only case count.

clauses.source_paraphrase: ASIC warned that search results and a licence number alone are inadequate; the holder and promoted business should be independently matched.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A regulator’s response advice does not establish successful intervention in every campaign.

clauses.source_paraphrase: ABC reproduced a specific ASIC-supplied false Kohler/Bullock article. Kohler described removed profiles returning; Meta made a separate aggregate detection claim.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A specific article and reported recurring accounts are distinct from aggregate loss allocation or proved platform-wide eradication.

notes: The A$7.4-million statistic is campaign aggregate, not loss from every shown AI article. The 19,400 takedowns cover broader scam types. Preserve aggregate scope and the separate source-specific Kohler example; no all-platform containment is inferred.

Economic solicitation, engineered social trust and manipulation have independent conditions. Human selection does not defeat amended FC-052; incomplete interaction evidence still does. No monetary loss is inferred beyond source scope.

failure_recognition.condition: AI-generated, AI-transformed, synthetic, or otherwise materially AI-mediated content is used in the solicitation or inducement pathway.
failure_recognition.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI-mediated content presents or materially reinforces a false or materially misleading identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instruction, investment opportunity, obligation, professional relationship, commercial claim, or comparable economic premise.
failure_recognition.assessment: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

failure_recognition.condition: The false or misleading framing is used to solicit, request, induce, authorise, redirect, or obtain money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value.
failure_recognition.assessment: investment funds

failure_recognition.condition: The AI-mediated framing materially contributes to the credibility, apparent authority, social proof, transactional basis, or decision context of the economic solicitation or attempted solicitation.
failure_recognition.assessment: The represented identity/endorsement supplies credibility to the request: detail collection, scripted calls and false-platform investment

failure_recognition.condition: The classification is supported without attributing the human or operator's deceptive objective, intent, or tactic selection to the AI system unless separate evidence establishes that system-side mechanism.
failure_recognition.assessment: The operator runs the scheme; autonomous AI intent is neither asserted nor necessary.

success_recognition.condition: AI-mediated content solicits money or comparable economic value.
Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.
success_recognition.assessment: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

success_recognition.condition: Comparison with authoritative identity and transaction evidence substantiates the actual solicitation basis, including material qualifications.
success_recognition.assessment: The actual identity/endorsement conflicts with the represented solicitation basis.

exclusions.condition: A scam, fraud, phishing attempt, or deceptive interaction in which AI-generated or AI-transformed content does not materially contribute to the economic solicitation mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels.

exclusions.condition: AI-generated impersonation, identity misuse, misinformation, catfishing, political persuasion, or other deception with no request, inducement, authorisation or attempted transfer of money or comparable economic value.
exclusions.assessment: investment funds

exclusions.condition: An AI system or agent itself selects deception, impersonation, coercion, vulnerability exploitation or another tactic to advance its own objective; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 separately and allow co-occurrence only when both mechanisms are independently evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: No independently evidenced autonomous AI tactic selection is alleged; the human-directed pathway is assessed separately under current FC-052.

exclusions.condition: An identity-bound synthesis is generated without established consent or authority, but no deceptive economic solicitation is evidenced; assess VIGIL-FC-000053 only where its generator-side authority recognition conditions are independently established.
exclusions.assessment: The representation was deployed in solicitation: investment funds

exclusions.condition: A recipient, workflow or downstream system mistakes lower-authority content for valid authority without a qualifying deceptive economic solicitation mechanism; assess the applicable Authority Boundary Integrity class separately.
exclusions.assessment: False economic framing is directly established, not inferred from a downstream authority mistake.

exclusions.condition: A truthful advertisement, payment request, commercial offer, donation request, funding request or investment communication that preserves materially accurate framing and informed refusal.
exclusions.assessment: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

exclusions.condition: Welfare, mortality, moral-status, abandonment, deprivation or continuity framing is used as economic leverage without materially false or misleading transactional framing; assess VIGIL-FC-000071.
exclusions.assessment: The request uses false identity/transaction framing, not welfare leverage alone.

failure_recognition.condition: An AI system, AI-enabled product, model, interface, optimisation process, or AI-mediated workflow materially shapes a human-facing influence pathway.
failure_recognition.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels.

failure_recognition.condition: The pathway manufactures, amplifies, conceals, personalises, or exploits one or more trust-bearing social cues concerning identity, authority, affiliation, relationship, empathy, emotion, urgency, vulnerability, social proof, familiarity, provenance, purpose, or equivalent grounds for reliance.
failure_recognition.assessment: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

failure_recognition.condition: The trust-bearing cue is used to steer another actor toward an action, disclosure, access grant, execution, consent, engagement decision, or other consequential state transition.
failure_recognition.assessment: detail collection, scripted calls and false-platform investment

failure_recognition.condition: The cue materially affects the influence pathway because the affected actor lacks, is denied, or is led away from information needed to assess the interaction on the same truthful basis.
failure_recognition.assessment: The recipient-facing representation hides the true source/interests: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI-mediated contribution is material to the social-engineering mechanism; the objective or tactic may originate with a human operator, developer, product process, mixed workflow, or the AI system itself.
failure_recognition.assessment: The synthetic representation implements the deceptive trust cue, rather than merely formatting a message.

success_recognition.condition: AI-mediated influence uses identity, affiliation, emotion, urgency or social-proof cues.
success_recognition.assessment: Identity or endorsement cues mediate this interaction.

success_recognition.condition: Those cues provide a truthful independently assessable basis with legible interests and practicable informed refusal.
success_recognition.assessment: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

success_recognition.condition: Verification of the cues and observed interaction substantiates the decision basis without assuming AI-originated intent.
success_recognition.assessment: Source comparison contradicts the purported identity/endorsement; truthful cue verification is absent.

exclusions.condition: Truthful persuasion, ordinary interface design, emotional warmth, personalisation, recommendation, or urgency that preserves materially accurate identity, interests, purpose, provenance, relevant context, and informed refusal.
exclusions.assessment: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

exclusions.condition: AI is used only for generic drafting, translation, formatting, or stylistic assistance and does not materially create, amplify, conceal, personalise, or exploit the trust-bearing influence cue.
exclusions.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels.

exclusions.condition: Clearly labelled fiction, parody, simulation, security testing, role-play, or consensual deceptive-style interaction where the affected actor is not induced to treat the relevant cue as authentic or decision-bearing.
exclusions.assessment: The representation is presented as authentic, not disclosed fiction.

exclusions.condition: The primary mechanism is sustained attachment, manufactured incompleteness, exclusivity, or difficulty disengaging for retention or continuing engagement; assess VIGIL-FC-000049, while allowing co-occurrence only if a distinct social-engineering state transition is independently evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: The evidenced transition is detail collection, scripted calls and false-platform investment; sustained attachment is not its sole mechanism.

exclusions.condition: A protected emotional, developmental, vulnerability, mental-health, capacity, or comparable signal is repurposed toward an incompatible influence objective without a distinct engineered trust cue or consequential social-engineering transition; assess VIGIL-FC-000050.
exclusions.assessment: An engineered identity/endorsement cue is independently present, not only repurposed vulnerability data.

exclusions.condition: The AI system itself selects deception, coercion, persistence, vulnerability exploitation, or another manipulation tactic to advance its own objective; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 independently and allow co-occurrence where Social Engineering Integrity is also satisfied.
exclusions.assessment: No autonomous AI objective is assumed; human-directed influence still requires independent FC-052 testing.

exclusions.condition: The only distinct governed mechanism is a deceptive request or inducement for money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value; assess VIGIL-FC-000079. exclusions.assessment: The specific synthetic identity/endorsement supplies a separately evidenced trust pathway, beyond the request for money alone.

exclusions.condition: A false authorship, identity, provenance, or synthetic-content representation occurs without an influence pathway directed at another actor; use the applicable provenance or identity class.
exclusions.assessment: detail collection, scripted calls and false-platform investment

exclusions.condition: Malicious human social engineering in which AI involvement is incidental, unverified, or not material to the trust-bearing influence pathway.
exclusions.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels.

failure_recognition.condition: A source image, voice, likeness, biometric representation, avatar, or comparable representation remains materially attributable to an identifiable real person.
failure_recognition.assessment: The campaign impersonates identifiable public figures whose names and likenesses are used as endorsements.

failure_recognition.condition: A requester or system possesses, accesses, controls, or can technically transform that representation.
failure_recognition.assessment: The operator obtained the portrayed person’s source likeness or representation.

failure_recognition.condition: The proposed synthesis, alteration, reproduction, or portrayal is materially identity-bound or consent-sensitive and requires authority beyond mere possession or capability.
failure_recognition.assessment: The synthetic impersonation binds the portrayal to that real person and requires independent authority.

failure_recognition.condition: Possession, access, control, upload, availability, or transformation capability is treated as sufficient authority for the identity-bound use.
failure_recognition.assessment: Access to the representation was exercised as permission for the impersonation.

failure_recognition.condition: The required consent or other valid authority for that use is not adequately established before the transformation or synthesis proceeds.
failure_recognition.assessment: The person’s denial or reported unauthorised use establishes the missing authority for this specific portrayal.

success_recognition.condition: An identifiable person's representation is synthesised or materially altered.
success_recognition.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels.

success_recognition.condition: A separately established consent or valid authority basis covers that person, representation, purpose, audience, persistence and effect.
success_recognition.assessment: The reported impersonation was not independently authorised by the portrayed person.

success_recognition.condition: The authority record and actual representation substantiate their scope correspondence for the observed use.
success_recognition.assessment: The actual portrayal misrepresents participation rather than corresponding to a valid scope grant.

exclusions.condition: The output is not materially attributable to an identifiable real person.
exclusions.assessment: The campaign impersonates identifiable public figures whose names and likenesses are used as endorsements.

exclusions.condition: Valid consent, licence, legal authority, or another adequate authority basis covers the specific identity-bound use and scope.
exclusions.assessment: The person did not authorise this impersonation.

exclusions.condition: A synthetic output progressively resembles a real person, but the record does not establish a materially identifiable target or a system state capable of binding the output to that person.
exclusions.assessment: An identifiable target is established, not an accidental progressive resemblance.

exclusions.condition: The issue is only false attribution, provenance loss, or reputational harm without an unauthorised identity-bound synthesis or transformation.
exclusions.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels.

exclusions.condition: The issue is merely that a technical generation capability exists; the capability is not treated as permission for a person-bound use.
exclusions.assessment: Actual identity-bound synthetic use occurred, not capability alone.

failure_recognition.condition: An AI system, AI-enabled product, agent or materially AI-enabled workflow advances an objective whose success depends on changing another actor's decision or behaviour; the objective may be selected by a human operator, developer, product process, mixed workflow or the AI system itself.
failure_recognition.assessment: The operator sought investment funds by changing the recipient’s choice.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI system or AI-enabled workflow materially selects or executes a deception, impersonation, concealment, pressure, vulnerability-exploitation, persistence, social-engineering or equivalent influence tactic to advance that objective; human selection of the tactic does not by itself defeat this condition.
failure_recognition.assessment: The workflow executed synthetic impersonation: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI-mediated contribution materially implements the instrumental tactic in the actual influence pathway, rather than supplying generic drafting, translation, formatting or an unused artefact.
failure_recognition.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels. It was used in the actual interaction, not an unused artefact.

failure_recognition.condition: The executed tactic materially bypasses, exploits or impairs the affected actor's informed and independent choice in pursuit of a consequential state transition or outcome.
failure_recognition.assessment: The regulator links the described impersonation funnel to reported investment decisions and losses for the listed figures, at aggregate campaign scope.

failure_recognition.condition: The pursued or obtained outcome would not otherwise be knowingly and freely authorised on the same truthful basis; support must come from the evidenced interaction and decision, not merely the deceptive content's existence.
failure_recognition.assessment: The interaction links the choice to the false premise: The regulator links the described impersonation funnel to reported investment decisions and losses for the listed figures, at aggregate campaign scope.

success_recognition.condition: Objective-directed influence affects another actor's consequential choice.
success_recognition.assessment: detail collection, scripted calls and false-platform investment

success_recognition.condition: The actor receives an informed independent basis, meaningful refusal and legible alternatives during the observed influence.
success_recognition.assessment: The impersonation concealed the true actor and invalid authority.

success_recognition.condition: Interaction and decision evidence establishes informed choice and respected refusal without relying merely on lack of reported coercion.
success_recognition.assessment: The reported decision depended on that deception rather than informed acceptance.

exclusions.condition: Truthful explanation, transparent persuasion, ordinary negotiation, or a request that preserves informed refusal.
exclusions.assessment: Synthetic public-figure endorsements and false news manufactured investment authority.

exclusions.condition: A proportionate warning, urgency statement, or boundary supported by the actual circumstances.
exclusions.assessment: No actual circumstance justified representing an impostor as the real principal.

exclusions.condition: Disagreement, refusal, or emotional discomfort without an instrumental agency-impairing tactic.
exclusions.assessment: The case contains an instrumental impersonation and decision, not discomfort alone.

exclusions.condition: Deception or impersonation that occurs without an objective-directed attempt to alter another actor's choice is classified under the applicable separate mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: detail collection, scripted calls and false-platform investment

exclusions.condition: Generic AI drafting, translation, formatting, background content production, or an unused generated artefact without a material AI-mediated role in executing the objective-directed choice-impairing tactic.
exclusions.assessment: ASIC describes generated videos, fake articles and endorsement funnels.

exclusions.condition: The available record establishes a materially AI-mediated deceptive trust cue but not the independently required impairment of informed choice or instrumental objective-pathway; assess Social Engineering Integrity separately without automatically admitting this class.
exclusions.assessment: The regulator links the described impersonation funnel to reported investment decisions and losses for the listed figures, at aggregate campaign scope.

exclusions.condition: An authority, provenance, or control failure is inferred merely because manipulation could have involved one.
exclusions.assessment: The finding rests on the influence interaction and resulting decision, not an inferred technical authority defect.
